title: Tavern 0.6.218: reduce duplicate font resources and bound seat scans
public_notes_inline: Share 32 byte-identical board font pages while preserving every logical glyph and its original pixels, UVs, layout, tint and outline. Bound seat maintenance to its existing 128-handle batch without copying the whole registry. Remove 8 MiB of nominal RGBA8 texture pixels; actual device memory and frame-time savings remain unmeasured. Source/adapter checks only; no native client, saved-world or LIVE acceptance.
